How this is collected

  • Source: official AION2 character search and character info/equipment APIs, fetched on 2026-10-07.
  • For every server and class, up to 100 level 50 characters are sampled; the 30 with the highest combat power are used for the build statistics.
  • Only aggregated numbers are stored. No character names or IDs are kept or shown.
  • Numbers reflect the sampled characters, not the whole server population.
